name: Octree-GS
definition: A hierarchical LoD method that builds an octree over the scene, associating each node with a merged Gaussian that summarizes the radiance and opacity of its children.
summary: Octree-GS is a hierarchical level-of-detail method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses a strict octree hierarchy to merge Gaussians, distinguishing itself from voxel-grid scaffolding or clustering approaches.
